name: Commerce Command Center
description: A cinematic Three.js ops floor — region platforms, category towers, channel particle flows, and a multi-KPI HUD driven by rich mapped commerce data.
author: DataCheetah
insights: Region platforms — compare markets on a circular command floor
Category towers — see product-line mix rise on each pad
Channel flows — particle streams show Direct, Marketplace, and Retail share
Multi-KPI HUD — revenue, orders, customers, and margin while you scrub years
Bring your own CSV — map year, region, category, channel, and measures
